note: x is a lineage's metabolic efficiency, y the pawn's hunger rate (wiki: Frostkin -1 is x125%, Warbred +2 is x80%, baseline x100%). Between and beyond the points the curve is straight lines, flat at the ends.
note2: sneed 2026-11-19 (docs/design/races.md): the player and the starting colonists are human; joiners and raiders roll their race from joinerLineageWeights. Dark is light under 0.3 (the Dark thought's), the sun is up while its glow is over 0.3.
